title: Two group-actions quantize the SAME law: dilation ⟨g^t⟩ on bad-scalars (F3) vs coset μ_n on frequencies (F2); gcd(t,n) the dictionary
evidence: Exact-integer probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C023_orbit_count.py (+ _C023_quick.py, _C023_n24.py, _C023_n32fast.py) over proper dyadic subgroups μ_n at large primes q=1 mod n with (q-1) not a 2-power: n=16 (q=65617,β=4), n=32 (q=1048609,β=4), n=24 control (q=13873,β=3); k=ρn, ρ∈{1/4,1/2}; computed lacBad(μ_n,k+t,t)={e_t(S):S⊆μ_n,|S|=k+t,e_1=..=e_{t-1}=0} exhaustively over the vanishing variety, plus the orbit count #lacBad/(n/gcd(t,n)). BACKBONE CONFIRMED: lacBad is closed under γ↦g^t·γ in EVERY row (closed=True), reproducing in-tree lacBad_smul_closed and eta coset-invariance — the 'two actions' framing is descriptively correct. NOVEL CLAIM (C) REFUTED & BACKWARDS: attack_plan asserts orbit count is O(1) exactly when gcd(t,n)=1. Measured the opposite: coprime t=1 gives the LARGEST orbits (n=16:141 at ρ=1/4, 205 at ρ=1/2; n=32 deep all 0; n=24:578=q-1); the O(1)-orbit rows (orbits=1,5) sit at LARGE gcd (n=16 t=4 gcd=4 orbits=1; t=2 gcd=2 orbits=5; n=24 t=4 gcd=4 orbits=1, t=3 gcd=3 orbits=5). So the proposed reduction 'floor reduces to coprime-t directions, t-even handled by μ_{n/2} self-similar collapse' is invalid: the worst-case incidence lives precisely at the coprime t=1 direction the plan would discard. NOVEL CLAIM (D) REFUTED: #lacBad split is governed by gap size t (small t near-capacity → huge; large t window → 0), NOT by parity; the genuine odd-t≥3⇒empty-variety phenomenon for dyadic μ_n is the Lam–Leung antipodal/negation-pairing structure already on record as the char-0 side of W-BGK, not a new t-power-map dictionary. ALSO: in-tree quantization docstring ('#lacBad a multiple of n/gcd') has an unstated fixed-point caveat — fails when γ=0∈img or a=n (n=16 t=4: #lacBad=5∤unit=4; n=24 t=1,2 mult=False; n=32 t=24 #lacBad=1); the Lean lemma proves only closure, which is fine, but freeness (needed for the multiple) does not hold.
honest_note: The structural backbone of C023 (frequency μ_n-coset invariance of η_b AND bad-scalar ⟨g^t⟩-closure of lacBad) is genuine and already axiom-clean in-tree (GaussPeriodCosetReduction.eta_image_card_mul_le, DyadicLacunaryDeltaStar.lacBad_smul_closed); I only REFUTE the connection's NEW quantitative prediction (the gcd-dictionary that would reduce the prize floor to coprime-t directions), which exact computation inverts. Probes are exhaustive over the constraint variety at small dyadic n (8/16/32) and one non-dyadic control (24); they do not reach prize n=2^30, but the orbit/gcd inversion is structural (degree-t homogeneity e_t(gS)=g^t e_t(S) makes coprime t act with full order n on γ, hence MORE distinct values, not fewer) and is unlikely to flip at larger n. n=32 only the deep window t≥16 is exhaustively feasible (all empty, as predicted by Lam–Leung), so the large-incidence inversion is witnessed at n=16/24, not n=32. No closure of the open core was attempted or claimed; C023 welds back to W-BGK (the char-0 Lam–Leung simultaneous-vanishing wall already named in the floor's residual). Recommend a DISPROOF_LOG entry for the gcd-dictionary attack-plan claim.
